biotools.summary: The Gut Analysis Toolbox (GAT) is an image analysis tool developed in Fiji for characterizing enteric neurons and their neurochemical coding. It streamlines image analysis tasks in ENS research, enabling rapid, unbiased analysis of larger tissue areas and neuronal markers.
